newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on higher volume.

text.p: Fresh buying by both retailers and institutions helped Dhaka stocks finish higher in an active session ahead of the Friday weekend, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange rose 28.59 points or 2.56 percent to 1,144.58. Gainers led losers by 106 to 28. Turnover rose to 79.4 million taka from the previous session's 54.2 million.
Square Pharma rose 36.53 taka to 1,054.44 and Monno Fabrics gained 2.86 to 141.
